Class D and E worlds with effective UWP hydrographics 1–A automatically have water available for fuel collection. The route planner requires ship fuel scoops to use this source. An explicit fuel-unavailable override takes precedence; hydrographics 0 or unknown does not establish water. Effective UWP overrides apply. This is a campaign ruling; it does not imply refined fuel or a fuel vendor at a Class E port (Class D already supplies purchased unrefined fuel).
